verses.html: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.html: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.text: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

verses.html: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
verses.text: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

verses.html: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.text: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

verses.html: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.text: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

verses.html: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.text: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

verses.html: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.text: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

verses.html: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.text: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

verses.html: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.text: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

verses.html: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.text: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

verses.html: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.text: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

verses.html: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
verses.text: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

verses.html: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.text: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

verses.html: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.text: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

verses.html: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.text: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

verses.html: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.text: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

verses.html: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.text: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

verses.html: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.text: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

verses.html: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.text: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

verses.html: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.text: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

verses.html: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
verses.text: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
